# Settings quick add

Status: **Partly built** · Section: Navigation, search, and commands · [All features](README.md)

## What is there

main.ts `refuseLocked`: the two messages that point at a setting (editing locked, tabs locked) carry a button that changes it on the spot, and respect a locked setting
